App details

Bubble Level & Inclinometer

Check whether a surface is level and measure its tilt with your phone’s sensors.

In the worksPlannedAndroid

What it’s for

Use available sensors for horizontal, vertical and two-axis leveling, slope and inclination readings, with calibration and relative zero. Accuracy depends on the device.

Main features

  • Horizontal, vertical and two-axis leveling.
  • Calibration and a relative zero point.
  • Freeze a reading for easier viewing.
  • Accuracy depends on your device and calibration.

This app is being planned and is not yet available to download. The description presents its intended functions.

Features in detail

Leveling, calibration and easier readings

Level and inclinometer views

Place the phone on a surface or along an edge. Horizontal and vertical bubbles, a dual-bubble view, a two-axis circular level and large numeric inclination show its tilt. Auto view switches between circular level and angle view; lock a chosen view manually when needed.

Quick and two-position calibration

Use a stable reference surface for Quick Calibration. Precision Calibration measures on that surface, then after turning the phone 180°, to estimate its fixed offset. An unstable or inconsistent pair is not accepted. The correction can be saved; it does not make the phone a certified instrument.

Relative zero and frozen readings

Zero makes the current stable angle a temporary reference for comparing two surfaces; Reset Zero restores the calibrated absolute reference. Hold freezes the displayed reading for easier inspection, with a clear paused indication. Resume returns to live measurements without changing calibration.

Tolerance, sound and vibration

Choose ±0.1°, ±0.2°, ±0.5° or ±1.0° for the level/vertical indication. Optional sound and short vibration help identify the target while smoothing reduces jitter. Tolerance affects the indication, not the measured angle. The normal 0.1° display step is resolution, not guaranteed accuracy.

Orientation, screen and device limits

Use portrait or landscape and optionally lock screen orientation or keep the screen awake during measurement. Readings require working motion sensors; an unsupported device is identified rather than showing invented values. No camera or location permission is needed for leveling.

The escaping bubble

Tap the About logo seven times for an offline joke: the level bubble escapes its tube and travels across the screen. The closing message jokes about a surface not being level. The scene is separate from real sensor readings and calibration.

Use, settings and availability

Offline use

The main functions are designed to work on your device without a JN86 account. Ads, purchases and external links may need internet.

Language, settings and help

Choose one of eight app languages and adjust the available settings. About provides privacy information and a link to voluntary JN86 support. Support does not unlock paid functions. Availability is shown below.

Ads and optional ad removal

All described functions are planned to be free, with banner ads and optional one-time Google Play ad removal. No subscription is planned. The purchase screen shows the actual local price; purchase restoration uses Google Play.

Availability

This app is being created. The features described here are planned; it is not yet available to download.
